history.name: Sub-sections inside an area
history.description: A sub-section is a heading between an area and a feature, for an area with a real part inside it. Each one carries a name and a one-or-two-sentence overview of that part, and you file a feature into it when you record or update the feature. When every feature in a sub-section arrives in the same release, the edition flags the sub-section once rather than printing a column of identical New marks.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdSubcategory; .ledger/subcategories.json. FeatureSet#sections is the single layout both renderers walk. `ledger status` mentions a sub-section that leads with a Big entry, since its heading and intro already are that part's overview.
